summary: community.mysql was renamed to ansible.mysql; both ship for now, community.mysql becomes redirects in Ansible 14 and is removed in Ansible 17.
questions: Should I use community.mysql or ansible.mysql?
When will community.mysql be removed from Ansible?

answer_card.title: community.mysql renamed to ansible.mysql
answer_card.answer_md: `community.mysql` was renamed to **`ansible.mysql`**. Both are included for now; `community.mysql` content becomes deprecated redirects in **Ansible 14.0.0** and the collection is removed in **Ansible 17**. Update your FQCNs to `ansible.mysql`.
